lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mn2Pd2O8 (MnPO4) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Mn centers with six O neighbors and Pd centers with four O neighbors, while each O center has two geometric neighbors (one Mn, one Pd). The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Mn- and Pd-centered polyhedra.
